fragments.exact_quote: The Boolean type represents a logical entity having two values, called true and false.
fragments.reason_for_inclusion: Supports Boolean output shape and the Boolean-identity branch of ToBoolean.

fragments.exact_quote: The String type is the set of all ordered sequences of zero or more 16-bit unsigned integer values ("elements") up to a maximum length of 2∞53 - 1 elements. The String type is generally used to represent textual data in a running ECMAScript program, in which case each element in the String is treated as a UTF-16 code unit value. The length of a String is the number of elements within it. The empty String has length zero and therefore contains no elements.
